description: The minimum the popup window needs: show and hide itself, and drag a frameless window by its header. Two plugins are registered in `lib.rs` and deliberately granted nothing here. `clipboard-manager`: every clipboard write goes through the `copy_item` command, so a sensitive item's plaintext never has to enter the WebView in order to be copied, and `clipboard-manager:allow-write-text` would let any script in the WebView write the system clipboard directly. `dialog`: the save and open panels are driven from Rust in `commands::transfer`, so the chosen path is used on that side and never crosses the bridge (CLAUDE.md rule 4) — a JS grant would hand the WebView a way to obtain one. The app's own `#[tauri::command]`s are not gated by this file; only core and plugin commands are.
